handoff: review#2: 2 blocking findings. All green on HEAD: typecheck, unit 1103/0, integration 372/0, e2e 72/0. F1: the hints in transcript.ts:22/267 and observe-snapshot.ts:68 tell people to run 'NORN_TRANSCRIPT_UPDATE=1 bun test' with an old path, but bun test now ignores test/e2e, so they must say 'bun run test:e2e <file>' and test/e2e/... F2: B16 (repo.test.ts:213) skips everything under test/repo/, a unit tier; exempt only the rule's own file and add a fixture case. Minor: F36's cause is still unknown, so say so in the handoff and the PR (AC8). Golden adds 9 cases base adds too; put the evidence in the criteria report (AC6). The CP6 abort needs a fallback. test:cli, AGENTS and CI stay stale until slice 06.

findings.title: The hints for rewriting a transcript or snapshot give a command that no longer works
findings.detail:
transcript.ts:22 (doc comment: `NORN_TRANSCRIPT_UPDATE=1 bun test <file>` rewrites `test/transcripts/<name>.txt`), transcript.ts:267 and observe-snapshot.ts:68 (error text: 'run NORN_TRANSCRIPT_UPDATE=1 bun test on this file'). The root bunfig now ignores test/e2e/**, and `bun test ./test/e2e/pinned-outputs.test.ts` finds no test file. The files also now live in test/e2e/transcripts/. A person who follows the error message gets nothing.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Say `NORN_TRANSCRIPT_UPDATE=1 bun run test:e2e <file>` and the path test/e2e/transcripts/<name>.txt (and test/e2e/observe-snapshots/). Optionally add a repo rule that no source text tells people to run plain `bun test` on an e2e file.

findings.title: B16 skips everything under test/repo/, which is a unit tier
findings.detail:
B16: 'only e2e tests use the transcript and observe snapshot helpers'; D6: test/repo/ is the unit tier for repo rules and script tests, and slice 05 moves the repo tests there. The filter `!f.startsWith("test/repo/")` lets any unit test under test/repo/ (test/repo/unit-guard.test.ts exists today) import test/support/transcript.ts without being flagged.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Exempt only the file that holds the B16 rule or its fixture (for example test/repo.test.ts, or the fixture path), not the whole folder. Add a fixture case with a file under test/repo/ that imports the helper and must be flagged.

findings.title: F36's parallel-only failure: cause unknown, only diagnostics added
findings.detail:
AC8: 'the cause of any parallel-only failure is fixed, not retried around, and named in the handoff.' F36 did not reproduce, in this review's run either. baseDiagnostics only prints when the story list is missing gh-5, and it reaches into store's base cache.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Say in the handoff and the PR that the cause is unknown and the failure did not reproduce. If it recurs, fix it at its cause. Remove the diagnostics once that is settled, or file a follow-up issue.

findings.title: golden adds 9 cases
findings.detail:
AC6 says '`bun run golden` adds no case'. The implementer reports that base adds the same 9 of 604, so these are pre-existing gaps in the corpus.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Put the base-vs-head comparison in the criteria report and the PR, or amend AC6 and B18.

findings.title: The CP6 abort depends on a frame being logged
findings.detail:
If projectView throws, nothing is logged and the loop sleeps on its 1h interval. The test then fails on its timeout instead of an assertion, and the 1h timer stays alive.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Add a generous fallback abort, or an abort in afterEach, so a missing frame fails fast and cleanly.

findings.title: test:cli now runs only the cli unit tests, and AGENTS and CI are stale until slice 06
findings.detail:
The root bunfig ignore patterns also apply to `bun test ./packages/cli/test`, so it runs 5 files. AGENTS.md:9-28 still describes `bun test` as the full suite, and ci.yml runs only `bun test`, so integration and e2e do not run in CI.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Slice 06 owns this. State it in the handoff and the PR, and make sure slice 06 lands before the story merges.

findings.title: Tier selection is checked against a model of bun built with Bun.Glob, which collects only *.test.ts
findings.detail:
Bun also picks up _test, .spec and _spec files. The bunfig.integration.toml glob {[!i]*,i[!n]*} would also select a folder such as inbox/, though the equality check would catch that.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: State the assumption in the PR. QA's tier runs should confirm the file counts.

findings.title: Unused import and small smells
findings.detail:
The `ulid` import is unused. test/repo.test.ts reads package.json scripts the same way 3 times. `grew = !!pinned.add(f)` relies on Set.add returning the set. observe-snapshot re-exports observeNow only to pass it through.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Clean these up while fixing F1 and F2.
